sections.title: Tax on non-resident sportsmen or sports associations.

subsections.text_before_clauses: Where the total income of an assessee,—

clauses.text_before_sub_clauses: being a sportsman (including an athlete), who is not a citizen of India and is a non-resident, includes any income received or receivable by way of—

sub_clauses.text: participation in India in any game [other than a game the winnings from which are taxable as specified in section 194(1) (Table: Sl. No. 1)] or sport; or
contribution of articles relating to any game or sport in India in newspapers, magazines or journals; or

clauses.text: being a non-resident sports association or institution, includes any amount guaranteed to be paid or payable to such association or institution in relation to any game, other than a game the winnings from which are taxable as specified in section 194(1) (Table: Sl. No. 1) or sport played in India; or

being an entertainer, who is not a citizen of India and is a non-resident, includes any income received or receivable from his performance in India, then, the aggregate of income-tax payable by the assessee shall be computed at the rate specified in the column C applied on the corresponding income specified in column B:—

table.title: TABLE

rows.column_B: Income referred to in clause (a) or (b) or (c). 20%
rows.raw_text: Income referred to in clause (a) or (b) or (c). 20%

rows.column_B: Total income as reduced by income referred to in clause (a) or (b) or (c). Rates in force.
rows.raw_text: Total income as reduced by income referred to in clause (a) or (b) or (c). Rates in force.

table.linearized_text: Clause (c): being an entertainer, who is not a citizen of India and is a non-resident, includes any income received or receivable from his performance in India, then, the aggregate of income-tax payable by the assessee shall be computed at the rate specified in the column C applied on the corresponding income specified in column B:— Table items: Item 1 - Nature of sum: Income referred to in clause (a) or (b) or (c). 20%. Item 2 - Nature of sum: Total income as reduced by income referred to in clause (a) or (b) or (c). Rates in force..

subsections.text: No deduction in respect of any expenditure or allowance shall be allowed under any provision of this Act in computing the income referred to in subsection (1).

subsections.text_before_clauses: It shall not be necessary for the assessee to furnish a return of his income under section 263(1), if—

clauses.text: his total income during the tax year consisted only of income referred to in sub-section (1); and
the tax deductible at source under the provisions of Chapter XIX-B has been deducted from such income.
